# OMNIVOX AI

> Cloud dialer and agent workspace for UK and EU outbound sales teams. Preview and manual outbound, platform-managed telephony, and one prepaid credit wallet for inbound and outbound calls.

OMNIVOX AI is operated by Quanterae Solutions. The platform fee is £25 per agent per month. Telephony is prepaid at approximately 5p per connected minute. There is no bundled “unlimited minutes” fair-use cap — usage is visible in Admin → Call Credits.

## Pages

- [Home](https://omnivox-website-three.vercel.app/): Product overview, metered pricing, compliance summary, and FAQ
- [Features](https://omnivox-website-three.vercel.app/features): Dialing modes, agent workspace, credit wallet, inbound routing, campaigns, and compliance tools
- [Pricing](https://omnivox-website-three.vercel.app/pricing): £25/seat plus prepaid credits, cost calculator, and top-up packs
- [Agencies](https://omnivox-website-three.vercel.app/agencies): Same-day client onboarding, multi-org isolation, and pilot credit grants
- [Trust & Security](https://omnivox-website-three.vercel.app/trust): UK GDPR controller/processor roles, DPA, DNC, audit logs, and recording controls
- [Contact](https://omnivox-website-three.vercel.app/contact): Book a demo or start a same-day pilot
- [Privacy Policy](https://omnivox-website-three.vercel.app/privacy): How website and platform data is handled
- [Terms of Service](https://omnivox-website-three.vercel.app/terms): Platform usage terms

## Product facts

- Manual dial and preview dial are available today
- Progressive and predictive auto-dial is in development
- One prepaid credit wallet covers inbound and outbound
- Platform-managed telephony — no carrier accounts required
- Call recording is configurable per organisation or campaign
- UK GDPR: the customer is the data controller; OMNIVOX AI is the data processor
- A Data Processing Agreement is provided at onboarding
- Contact: hello@omnivox.co.uk
- App login: https://omnivox-ai.vercel.app/login
